methodology.ranking: Percentiles are computed within each peer group, not across the whole batch. Comparing a bond fund's Sharpe to an equity fund's produces a number, not a finding.
methodology.cost: Expense ratio, tracking difference against the fund's own index proxy, and NAV premium/discount. The expense ratio alone is not the cost of ownership.
methodology.disclosure: Premium/discount and median 30-day bid-ask spread come from issuer Rule 6c-11 disclosures where configured, and from quote NAV otherwise.
